text:
sanjay: heads up — CI perf/regression spike on rollout 2026-03-18, lots of OOMs during long-prompt e2e tests :rotating_light:
mei: saw that. it's the dedicated-kernel path? perf-bot shows memory growth at kernel_select stage.
elena: link to CI run: https://ci.internal.redwood/rez/1234 — failing on batch packing test C (seq len mix).
ryan: I pulled logs — OOMs inside kv_cache::evict_window when a large short+long batch arrives. eviction loop thrashes and pages spike.
mei: exact error from node-12: "std::bad_alloc at kv_cache.cpp:412" then stack shows `KernelRouter::select_best` -> fallback to fp32 kernels.
sanjay: commit that landed earlier tonight: abc1234 "evict: prefer recency over density" — might be the trigger.
elena: perf-bot attached profile: top flame shows `select_best` spending 60% of CPU and memcpy hotspots right after. attaching snippet:

```
# perf top
  60.1% KernelRouter::select_best
  15.7% kv_cache::evict_window
  12.3% memcpy
```

ryan: hypothesis: new eviction favors keeping fragmented small slices which makes later long seqs force fallback to fp32 kernels and memory blow up. batching heuristic groups by arrival, not seq len, so pathologic mix can appear.
mei: can reproduce locally with synthetic workload: 80% seq64 + 20% seq4096 packed into same batch size 16. reproduces OOM within ~120s.
sanjay: rolling hold? deploy-bot: currently rolling out to 20% — we should pause.
deploy-bot: HOLD placed on rollout 2026-03-18T02:00Z by sanjay (reason: CI perf regression / OOM surge).
elena: bisect request — can someone check rollback candidates between 2134560000..2134568000, start with abc1234 revert.
ryan: bisect log: reverting abc1234 locally removes the thrash, memory stays stable and kernel selection picks quantized path again.
mei: quick workaround: shrink batch packing window to avoid mixing long/short in same batch, will add flag `--batch-pack-max-seqlen-delta=512`.
sanjay: good. please open PR for pack-window guard and test on CI. also mark release blocked until patch.
elena: opened PR #4723 with pack-window guard + telemetry for kernel fallback counts.
ryan: CI run for #4723 started: https://ci.internal.redwood/rez/4723 (smoke + perf).
mei: telemetry shows fallback_count dropping from 27/min to 1/min on synthetic test.
sanjay: leaving note for release: DO NOT PROMOTE until 24h of perf stability on stage. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: summary metric: kv_eviction_rate + kernel_fallback_count spiked 6x post-abc1234, currently down 95% on stage with #4723 applied.
deploy-bot: rollout still on HOLD (manual) — next action by eng-runtime leads.
ryan: follow-ups: (1) add unit tests to ensure batch packing respects seqlen bounds, (2) add a small stress test mixing seq lengths, (3) consider kernel selection fallback thresholds to avoid fp32 unless memory headroom check passes.
mei: noted. creating tickets for 1/2/3.
sanjay: will file a postmortem with timeline after we confirm stage stability. short-term: revert or patch (#4723). long-term: revisit eviction scoring to account for density.
